26 25 0:30 /@home /home rw,relatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,space_cache,subvolid=256,subvol=/@home

rationale: preseal-amendment.md §C2 final rules (superseding contract.md §C2 only where the original clause was erroneous/ambiguous), plus the kernel sources: mount resolution (amendment, 'Mount resolution' bullet): the fixture mountinfo is parsed per proc.rst §3.5 field layout [S082]; candidate covering mountpoints for realpath /home/quota/data are '/' and '/home'; the longest component-prefix wins, and neither covering mountpoint occurs more than once in the file, so no ambiguous_overmount refusal applies; the trailing empty line after the last record is ignored. The chosen line '26 25 0:30 /@home /home rw,relatime shared:1 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,space_cache,subvolid=256,subvol=/@home' is parsed by its separator and its last three fields, giving fstype 'btrfs', source '/dev/mapper/root' and super options 'rw,space_cache,subvolid=256,subvol=/@home'; no backslash escapes occur, so no escape rejection. Device check (amendment, 'Device mismatch PREEMPTS the filesystem table' bullet): the chosen fstype is btrfs and the path's stat major is 0 (st_dev 0:57), so the btrfs equality skip applies and the mismatch against the mount major:minor 0:30 does not preempt the filesystem table; a btrfs subvolume reports its own anonymous device (S081 = fs/btrfs/inode.c, inode.c:8246 'stat->dev = BTRFS_I(inode)->root->anon_dev'), which is exactly the case the skip encodes. Quota classification (amendment, 'btrfs' bullet): the raw decoded source '/dev/mapper/root' is looked up in device_links and yields the mapped basename 'dm-0'; exactly one uuid record lists 'dm-0', its qgroups (directory present) is true and its qgroups_enabled is true, so the outcome is quota_state 'enabled', enforcement 'unknown', basis 'btrfs_qgroups_enabled' (the amendment's renamed basis for present-plus-enabled-true; the original contract token btrfs_qgroups_dir_present is superseded because directory presence alone means initialized, not enabled). The qgroups_enabled value models /sys/fs/btrfs/<uuid>/qgroups/enabled, whose reader is qgroup_enabled_show [S079 = fs/btrfs/sysfs.c], and the mode text 'qgroup' is the informational value emitted by qgroup_mode_show for BTRFS_QGROUP_MODE_FULL [S079]; the qgroups directory itself is created by btrfs_sysfs_add_qgroups when qgroup support is turned on [S080 = fs/btrfs/qgroup.c, call sites qgroup.c:441 and :1032, creation in fs/btrfs/sysfs.c:2586]. Verdict (amendment, output/verdict section, unchanged precedence): the single path is enabled and no path is unknown, so exit 1 and finding_id 'QUOTA_ENABLED'. Fixture-format conformance (amendment, 'Paths' and UUID rules): the path is nonempty, unique, normalized and absolute with no dot/dotdot components, st_dev '0:57' is canonical decimal MAJ:MIN with no signs or leading zeros, the UUID key is canonical, the device basename 'dm-0' is a plain nonempty basename without slashes, and the uuid record carries exactly the keys devices, qgroups, qgroups_enabled, qgroups_mode with bool / bool / mode-or-null types; the btrfs super options carry no quota keys, so quota_option_keys is empty by the amendment's btrfs rule.
